images.title: Is the giraffe at (9,8)?
images.purpose: Show that (8,9) and (9,8) are two different places: the giraffe stands at column 8 and row 9, while column 9 and row 8 is a spot with no animal.
images.composition: The same 12 by 12 grid as the previous concept, with the giraffe at (8,9) and a vermilion dot at (9,8), each joined to its two numbers by dashed guide lines and rings; on the right two boxes that say the walk for each pair.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top right of the grid, centred at x 1040 and y 60, the title Is the giraffe at (9,8)? in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). THE GRID: one grid of 12 columns by 12 rows of equal squares, every square 52 by 52 px, so the grid is 624 px wide and 624 px tall and holds exactly 144 squares; it covers x 130 to 754 and y 100 to 724, with thin grey #6B7280 grid lines (2 px), a 3 px dark #2B2B2B outline, and the bottom left corner at x 130, y 724. NUMBERS: along the bottom, under the grid, the 13 numbers 0 to 12 in teal #0072B2 bold 28 px, centred at y 752, one under each vertical line, number k at x 130 plus 52 times k (0 at x 130, 8 at x 546, 9 at x 598, 12 at x 754); up the left side, left of the grid, the 12 numbers 1 to 12 in reddish purple #CC79A7 bold 28 px, right aligned to end at x 116, one beside each horizontal line, number k at y 724 minus 52 times k (1 at y 672, 8 at y 308, 9 at y 256, 12 at y 100). There is no 0 on the left side. THE GIRAFFE: one amber #E69F00 circle 30 px across with a 3 px dark outline, centred at x 546, y 256 (column 8, row 9); the word giraffe, dark bold 28 px, left aligned from x 572 at y 240. THE RED DOT: one vermilion #D55E00 circle 30 px across with a 3 px dark outline, centred at x 598, y 308 (column 9, row 8); the pair (9,8), dark bold 28 px, left aligned from x 624 at y 308. No animal and no other picture is on the grid. GUIDE LINES, 4 px dashed: two amber #E69F00 lines from the giraffe, one straight down the vertical line at x 546 from y 271 to y 724 and one straight left along the horizontal line at y 256 from x 531 to x 130; two vermilion #D55E00 lines from the red dot, one straight down the vertical line at x 598 from y 323 to y 724 and one straight left along the horizontal line at y 308 from x 583 to x 130. FOUR RINGS, 4 px, 40 px across: around the bottom number 8 (x 546, y 752) an amber ring; around the bottom number 9 (x 598, y 752) a vermilion ring; around the left number 9 (x 104, y 256) an amber ring; around the left number 8 (x 104, y 308) a vermilion ring. COMPASS: a compass card, a square 110 by 110 px at x 1300 to 1410 and y 30 to 140, white with a #2B2B2B outline (3 px), with N at the top (centred at x 1355, y 54), S at the bottom (x 1355, y 116), W at the left (x 1324, y 85) and E at the right in red #D55E00 (x 1386, y 85), all bold 24 px, at the top right. RIGHT PANEL, x 840 to 1400: two boxes. Box A: a white rounded rectangle at x 840 to 1400 and y 170 to 380 with a 4 px amber #E69F00 outline, holding the pair (8,9) in dark bold 80 px, left aligned from x 880 at y 260, and under it, dark 32 px, left aligned from x 880 at y 340, the text 8 steps east, then 9 steps north. Box B: a white rounded rectangle at x 840 to 1400 and y 410 to 620 with a 4 px vermilion #D55E00 outline, holding the pair (9,8) in dark bold 80 px, left aligned from x 880 at y 490, to its right the text no animal here in dark bold 32 px left aligned from x 1130 at y 490, and under them, dark 32 px, left aligned from x 880 at y 570, the text 9 steps east, then 8 steps north. BOTTOM TEXT: dark 32 px, left aligned from x 840, at y 690 and y 730, the text The first number is the column. The second number is the row. wrapped on two lines after the first sentence. In all: 1 grid of 144 squares, 25 numbers, 1 giraffe, 1 red dot, 4 dashed guide lines, 4 rings, 2 boxes, 1 compass card. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: The first number is the column. The second number is the row.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
the giraffe and the red dot at the same place, or the red dot with an animal on it
a grid with a row or column count other than 12 by 12
guide lines that end at a different number from the one stated
images.takeaway: The first number is the column and the second number is the row, so (8,9) and (9,8) are two different places: the giraffe is at (8,9).
images.description: A 12 by 12 grid with the giraffe at (8,9) and a red dot at (9,8), each joined by dashed lines to its column and row numbers, and two boxes saying 8 steps east then 9 north and 9 steps east then 8 north.
images.context: Concept image for The Order of the Two Numbers. It follows the idea of the zoo grid in your maths book and uses this concept's own pair (8,9) and (9,8), not the pairs asked in the book's questions.
images.teaching_notes: Follow each dashed line down to the bottom number and left to the side number, and say east first. The slip to watch: reading the pair as row first, which lands on the wrong place.

image_decisions.why: Two markers on one grid with guide lines to their numbers make the difference between (8,9) and (9,8) visible, which words alone do not.
